title: 第486章 反向压制
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
面对姑苏明月突然起来的攻击，林雲依旧一脸懵逼，紫瞳神魂当即触发抵挡住姑苏明月的鬼魅神魂攻击。
“渣男！负心汉！”姑苏明月发飙的怒骂道，即使盛怒之下依然是英姿飒爽，足以让人沦陷。
林雲破开姑苏明月的鬼魅神魂攻击，认出姑苏明月的身份，不过林雲仍旧不知道发生了什么事情。
姑苏明月没有继续搭理林雲，既然林雲已经认出自己了，那此行的目就已经达到了！
众人见姑苏明月的鬼魅神魂功法被破，直接破空离开了欧阳山庄，什么话也没有留下。林雲摸着后脑门，一脸的懵逼。
欧阳庄主等人没有阻止姑苏明月的离去，毕竟万宝阁在黑影大陆是极为强大的势力，万宝阁的暗网体系极为强大，即使黑影王朝都不会去招惹的强大存在，欧阳家族就更不会去挑战万宝阁了。
欧阳山庄主也饶有兴趣知道，半年前在试炼魔鬼之地中力压欧阳冷傲，拿下试炼魔鬼之地第一名的林雲到底有多强大。
“林雲，今日可不会再让你逃走了！”欧阳冷傲指着周身的防御阵法说道。欧阳山庄擂台防御阵法部署了特殊的结界，结界的力量极为强大，哪怕是圣境级的修行者武者都无法轻易破开结界。
林雲微笑道：“欧阳冷傲，在试炼魔鬼之地中你都无法将我击杀，现在你就更没机会了！”
两人身上瞬间爆发出可怕的神威，欧阳冷傲浑身散发出金色圣光，璀璨的金光照亮了半边虚空。另外一半虚空则是被林雲的红色圣光所霸占。
content_en:
Facing Gusu Mingyue's sudden attack, Lin Yun was still confused. His purple-eyed soul immediately triggered to resist Gusu Mingyue's ghostly soul attack.
"Scumbag! A heartless man!" Gusu Mingyue yelled angrily. Even when she was furious, she was still heroic, enough to make people fall for her.
Lin Yun broke through Gusu Mingyue's ghost attack and recognized Gusu Mingyue's identity, but Lin Yun still didn't know what happened.
Gusu Mingyue did not continue to talk to Lin Yun. Now that Lin Yun had recognized her, the purpose of this trip had been achieved!
When everyone saw that Gusu Mingyue's ghost spirit technique was broken, they left Ouyang Villa directly without saying anything. Lin Yun touched the back of his forehead, looking confused.
Master Ouyang and others did not stop Gusu Mingyue from leaving. After all, Wanbao Pavilion is an extremely powerful force in the Black Shadow Continent. Wanbao Pavilion's dark network system is extremely powerful. Even the Black Shadow Dynasty will not provoke powerful beings, and the Ouyang family will not challenge Wanbao Pavilion.
The owner of Ouyang Villa is also very interested in knowing how powerful Lin Yun is, who defeated Ouyang Lengao in the Devil's Trial Land half a year ago and won the first place in the Devil's Trial Land.
"Lin Yun, I won't let you escape today!" Ouyang Lengao said, pointing to the defensive formation around him. A special barrier has been deployed in the Ouyang Villa arena defense formation. The barrier is extremely powerful, and even holy-level practitioners and warriors cannot easily break the barrier.
Lin Yun smiled and said: "Ouyang Lengao, you couldn't kill me in the devil's trial place, and now you have no chance!"
The two men instantly erupted with terrifying divine power. Ouyang Lengao's whole body exuded golden holy light, and the bright golden light illuminated half of the void. The other half of the void was occupied by Lin Yun's red holy light.
